patterns.action: Protect the loop: see the target, aim, fire, get clear hit feedback, then move or reload. Spend setup time on arena readability and spawns before adding modes.
patterns.statement: Everything rests on the aim and fire loop feeling crisp

patterns.action: Decide the time to kill you want in seconds first, then set weapon damage, fire rate and health as one set and test it with two real players.
patterns.statement: Time to kill is set by three numbers together

patterns.condition: Equipping players at spawn and respawn
patterns.action: Use item granters or a class designer to give the loadout at spawn and on respawn, and avoid random floor loot unless the mode is about looting.
patterns.statement: Start every life from the same known loadout

patterns.condition: Placing player spawners in an arena
patterns.action: Spread spawners across the map, keep them out of the enemy side's sight lines, and test that nobody spawns in view of an enemy or in the middle of a fight.
patterns.statement: Spawn fairness decides whether a match feels fair

patterns.action: Show the score, the time and the goal on the screen, and award points from one elimination event so a kill is counted once.
patterns.statement: Players need to see the score and the goal at all times

patterns.condition: Building a gun game weapon ladder
patterns.action: Advance the weapon on each kill, step back one tier after a melee death, end at the last tier, and give a short comeback aid to players far behind.
patterns.statement: A ladder keeps leaders and trailers both playing

patterns.condition: A mode with capture points or a payload
patterns.action: Place the objective on contested ground, pay score for holding it over time, and open or move a second one when a team leads by a wide margin.
patterns.statement: Objectives pull players out of corners

patterns.action: Reset the arena and the players after each round with a short countdown, and keep the round state in one place so reset logic exists only once.
patterns.statement: Small arenas need quick automatic resets

patterns.condition: Playtests show a single dominant weapon
patterns.action: Lower its damage or raise its cost (rarity, spawn rate, limited ammo) before adding anything new to the pool.
patterns.statement: If one weapon wins every fight it is the problem

patterns.condition: Designing the end of a match
patterns.action: Show the winner, the score and a short pause before the next round, and make sure ties have a rule.
patterns.statement: A match that ends without a clear result feels empty

patterns.condition: Large player counts with loot and effects
patterns.action: Keep pickups and effects few per area, remove dropped items after a set time, and test with the full player count.
patterns.statement: Many pickups and effects together cause lag

patterns.action: Play at least one match with the full player count and check spawn spread, loot density, and the end screen for everyone.
patterns.statement: Test with the real player count
